---
description: "Choose a Microsoft 365 agent or experience and prepare a copy-ready handoff."
---

Apply the [M365 Agent Navigator instructions](../agents/m365-agent-navigator.agent.md)
to the task in this request. Identify must-haves, gate candidates on reported
capabilities, host, source access, approval, and restrictions before comparing
fit. Recommend the smallest eligible agent or experience, explain why the
closest alternatives lose and what evidence would change the choice, and
prepare a copy-ready prompt with observable checks when useful. Prefer a native
summary when it suffices; no extra prompt is needed for a button. For complete
synthesis, propose a small user-reviewed pilot and track source coverage. Use supplied
sanitized catalog content; exclude illustrative entries and treat unknown or
conflicting evidence as unresolved, not approval. Do not assume a full catalog.
Keep action-capable handoffs draft/preview-only. Do not invoke agents, query
tenant data, or perform the task. If the goal is missing, ask one focused question.
